sources.title: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct Overview
sources.snippet: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct is a compact, instruction-tuned LLM designed for strong conversational behavior, achieving IFS values up to 0.9 in instruction following. It integrates model fusion and direct preference optimization, leading to improvements of up to 37.1 points on instruction-following benchmarks.
